title: MZPACK puts decoration and biomaterials at the heart of packaging innovation
summary: The Chinese packaging manufacturer combines advanced moulding and decoration capabilities with an expanding portfolio of alternative materials, including PHA, to help beauty brands create distinctive packaging while exploring more sustainable solutions. MZPACK recently showcased its expertise at Cosmopack Asia in Hong Kong. In an increasingly competitive beauty market, packaging is more than just a container: it is a key driver of product differentiation and brand identity. From surface... - MZPACK
